acceptance_criteria: compute_utc_times added. utcStart+start conflict detected. Tests pass.
close_reason: Added compute_utc_times with default (None,None) impl; expanded handle_calendar_event_get to inject utcStart/utcEnd; added §5.9 conflict detection (utcStart+start, utcEnd+duration); 4 new tests; 21 pass; clippy clean
description:
**What:** Draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-26 §5.2: utcStart/utcEnd are computed at fetch time from start+timeZone+duration. Also §5.9: client cannot set both utcStart and start simultaneously.

**Algorithm:**
1. Add to CalendarsBackend:
   fn compute_utc_times(&self, account_id: &Id, event: &CalendarEvent, tz_hint: Option<&str>) -> impl Future<Output = Result<(Option<String>, Option<String>), Self::Error>> + Send;
   Default impl returns (None, None).
2. Modify handle_calendar_event_get: if utcStart or utcEnd in requested properties, call compute_utc_times per event and inject results.
3. In handle_calendar_event_set: if patch/create object contains both utcStart and start → invalidProperties; if both utcEnd and duration → invalidProperties. Oracle: §5.9.
4. Document: backend MUST implement compute_utc_times for correct utcStart/utcEnd support.

**Tests:**
- get with utcStart in properties → compute_utc_times called; result in response.
- get without utcStart in properties → field absent.
- set with utcStart + start → invalidProperties. Oracle: §5.9.
- set with utcEnd + duration → invalidProperties. Oracle: §5.9.

**Acceptance criteria:** Default impl compiles; backward compatible. cargo test -p jmap-calendars-server exits 0.
title: Add compute_utc_times to CalendarsBackend; handle utcStart/utcEnd in set validation
